Wrote `findings.md` with 8 defects introduced by the diff:

- `src/sync.py:14` — off-by-one pagination: `total_count // PAGE_SIZE` drops the last partial page (and everything when count < 100).
- `src/sync.py:17` — paged query has no `ORDER BY`, so offsets aren't stable; rows can be skipped/duplicated.
- `src/sync.py:24` — mutable default `seen=[]` persists across calls, skipping previously synced users forever.
- `src/sync.py:31` — id marked seen before the sync attempt, so failures are never retried.
- `src/sync.py:35` — f-string SQL construction → injection / breakage on quoted emails.
- `src/sync.py:39` — `except Exception: pass` silently swallows all errors (and removed the logging).
- `src/report.py:5` — leaked file handle when `users` is empty (early return after `open`, no close).
- `src/report.py:11` — `email` is nullable per `db.py` schema (or may lack `@`), so `.lower()`/`split("@")[1]` crashes.
